dc:title: Riksdagen Persons CSV metadata
dc:description: CSVW table group metadata for the normalized CSV tables in the Riksdagen Persons repository.

tables.dc:title: Committees
tables.dc:description: Committee entities, including historical committees required by Ledamotsdata. The initial batch omits reused joint-committee codes pending incarnation resolution. Inception and dissolution are not inferred from the first and last observed memberships.

columns.name: committee_id
columns.dc:description: Stable SWERIK committee entity identifier. Retained across ordinary name changes, but not across dissolution and reconstitution.

columns.name: committee
columns.dc:description: Committee name in the source vocabulary.

columns.name: committee_type
columns.dc:description: Kind of parliamentary body.

columns.name: inception
columns.dc:description: Date of establishment, where independently known.

columns.name: dissolution
columns.dc:description: Date of dissolution, where independently known.

tables.dc:title: Committee abbreviations
tables.dc:description: Source abbreviations and spelling variants. Initial primary spellings follow the organ code table, or the verified historical source code. Blank validity dates do not assert timeless historical use. Raw aliases are retained alongside NFC spellings.

columns.name: committee_id
columns.dc:description: Stable SWERIK committee entity identifier. Retained across ordinary name changes, but not across dissolution and reconstitution.

columns.name: abbreviation
columns.dc:description: Exact source spelling, or its NFC counterpart.

columns.name: start
columns.dc:description: Source-supplied start date. Blank means unknown; no date is inferred.

columns.name: end
columns.dc:description: Source-supplied end date, including future dates. Blank means not supplied, not necessarily ongoing.

columns.name: primary_abbreviation
columns.dc:description: Whether this is the preferred spelling within the recorded validity period; initial periods are unknown.

tables.dc:title: Committee roles
tables.dc:description: Roles observed in Ledamotsdata committee assignments, verified against Riksdagen's role code table.

columns.name: committee_role_id
columns.dc:description: Stable identifier for a committee role.

columns.name: role
columns.dc:description: Exact role label from Riksdagen.

columns.name: role_class
columns.dc:description: Broad functional role. Deputerad is classified as ordinary_member.

columns.name: role_code
columns.dc:description: Riksdagen's official role code.

tables.dc:title: Committee memberships
tables.dc:description: Person-to-committee assignments from Ledamotsdata. Dates retain calendar days from source timestamps, which are preserved in references/committee-ledamotsdata. Exact duplicate assignments after date conversion are collapsed. Missing or ambiguous person matches and invalid intervals are reported rather than published. Coverage is incomplete and is not a complete membership roster for every date.

columns.name: person_id
columns.dc:description: Stable SWERIK person identifier.

columns.name: committee_id
columns.dc:description: Stable SWERIK committee entity identifier. Retained across ordinary name changes, but not across dissolution and reconstitution.

columns.name: start
columns.dc:description: Source-supplied start date. Blank means unknown; no date is inferred.

columns.name: end
columns.dc:description: Source-supplied end date, including future dates. Blank means not supplied, not necessarily ongoing.

columns.name: committee_role_id
columns.dc:description: Stable identifier for a committee role.

tables.dc:title: Committee external identifiers
tables.dc:description: Committee identifiers kept separately from person identifiers. Riksdagen organ codes are source-system identifiers and may label older assignments retrospectively; historical abbreviation periods do not restrict their import mapping.

columns.name: committee_id
columns.dc:description: Stable SWERIK committee entity identifier. Retained across ordinary name changes, but not across dissolution and reconstitution.

columns.name: authority
columns.dc:description: Identifier authority, such as riksdagen_org_code, wikidata, wikipedia_sv or wikipedia_en.

columns.name: identifier
columns.dc:description: Exact identifier within the named authority.

swerik:notes: This metadata file intentionally starts with conservative constraints. Historical date fields with mixed precision are represented as strings with date-like patterns rather than strict xsd:date values.
Additional project-specific ordering or curation annotations should use the swerik namespace so the core CSVW structure remains standards-compatible.
